source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Only to improve room appearance after procedures involving visibly contaminated equipment","B":"To replace sterile technique during the next procedure once environmental cleaning is complete","C":"To reduce environmental bioburden and the opportunity for pathogen transmission between cases","D":"Only after a client with a known infection leaves the room, rather than after routine procedures"}}
source_row.rationale: Between-case environmental cleaning and disinfection reduces contamination of high-touch and procedure-area surfaces and is one component of infection prevention. It complements rather than replaces aseptic and sterile technique.
source_row.source_detail: Environmental cleaning: reduce contamination/bioburden between patient-care episodes; reviewed 2026-08-14.
